mission.title: open-webui: issue: Web search results not passed to model in legacy path after upgrading to v0.9.6
mission.description: issue: Web search results not passed to model in legacy path after upgrading to v0.9.6. This issue affects 16+ users.

steps.title: Identify open-webui troubleshoot symptoms
steps.description:
Check for the issue in your open-webui deployment:
```bash
kubectl get pods -n open-webui -l app.kubernetes.io/name=open-webui
kubectl logs -l app.kubernetes.io/name=open-webui -n open-webui --tail=100 | grep -i error
```
Look for errors or warnings in the logs that may indicate the issue.

steps.title: Review open-webui configuration
steps.description:
Inspect the relevant open-webui configuration:
```bash
kubectl get all -n open-webui -l app.kubernetes.io/name=open-webui
kubectl get configmap -n open-webui -l app.kubernetes.io/part-of=open-webui
```

steps.title: Apply the fix for issue: Web search results not passed to model in legacy…
steps.description:
for everyone affected here, the (unsafe) temporary workaround is setting this env var:

ENABLE_RETRIEVAL_UNSCOPED_COLLECTIONS=true

Or, better: do not use the legacy tool calling system anymore. This is not supported anymore

steps.title: Confirm issue: Web search results not passed to model in… is resolved
steps.description:
Verify the fix by checking that the original error no longer occurs:
```bash
kubectl logs -l app.kubernetes.io/name=open-webui -n open-webui --tail=50 --since=5m
kubectl get events -n open-webui --sort-by='.lastTimestamp' | tail -10
```
Confirm that the issue symptoms are gone.

resolution.summary:
for everyone affected here, the (unsafe) temporary workaround is setting this env var:

ENABLE_RETRIEVAL_UNSCOPED_COLLECTIONS=true

Or, better: do not use the legacy tool calling system anymore. This is not supported anymore

the proper fix will be a small PR that will edit ~2 line of code.
